The only answer key for comparing versions; labels from before 10-16 are superseded (ep03 451 was wrongly 'hm right'). Evaluation only: fixes stay automatic (no manual annotation, user 10-15). orientation / position per version: ok | wrong | rough (roughly ok). 10-16 second pass on overlays that add 'best' (before the height post-process; review/pre/): parts judged separately where the user did. 10-16 22:10 third pass on the initialization pilot (dev/init_pilot: texture and coordinate-colour sheets, video | pilot_ctrl | pilot_init | best_dr2s_dyn7): 'init' = pilot_init; ep04 bat orientation right on all three, pose off enough to cost IoU; ep03 451 right.
